name: DownloadPipelineArtifactDev
description: Test-only Node replacement using an explicit local ArtifactTool build. Not for production.
helpMarkDown: Uses a trusted local ArtifactTool executable in the normal task target. Includes task-side container and file-share adapters; live service parity is not yet established.
author: Microsoft Corporation

inputs.name: artifactToolPath
inputs.label: Local development ArtifactTool executable
inputs.helpMarkDown: Absolute trusted executable path visible in the normal task target, including containers. No tool download or PATH lookup.

inputs.name: artifact
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Empty downloads all supported artifact types into artifact-specific layouts. Invalid artifact names fail before transfer.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.label: Matching patterns
inputs.helpMarkDown: Newline-delimited patterns. Exact matching parity across all artifact types remains an E2E gate.

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: Destination directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Absolute path or path relative to System.DefaultWorkingDirectory.

outputVariables.name: BuildNumber
outputVariables.description: Source build ID, not its display build number, for compatibility.

messages.DevelopmentOnly: Development-only task: invoking a trusted local ArtifactTool build. Production tasks and YAML shortcuts are unchanged.
